column1: # AME2020 Table I — the 2020 atomic mass table.
# Meng Wang, W.J. Huang, F.G. Kondev, G. Audi, S. Naimi,
# Chinese Physics C 45, 030003 (2021), Table I, pages 030003-6 to 030003-75.
# Extracted from the PDF supplied by M, pdftotext -layout, PDF pages 7-76.
# THIS IS THE PUBLISHED ROUNDED TABLE, not mass_1.mas20. AME rounds to a
# precision set by the uncertainty, so values differ from the ASCII file by
# up to ~0.1 sigma. Verified against the Argonne mass_1.mas20 text on the
# A = 9 chain: max deviation 4.174 keV on 9He, which is 0.089 sigma.
# A is RECOMPUTED as N + Z; the printed A is used only as a check and
# matched on every row where it appears (0 mismatches).
# quality: M = measured, E = estimated (# in the source).
